canonical_summary: Open ground is used for growing short, half-long and long carrots, onions, leeks, fine and half-fine chicories, turnips and radishes in March; melons, cucumbers, Italian chicory, cauliflowers, eggplants, lettuces and asparagus are also planted or sown here.
